observation.command:
cat > /tmp/verify.sh <<'VEOF'
#!/bin/bash
ok=0; fail=0; failed=""
while read img; do
  case "$img" in
    frontend|mfe-ewm|mfe-fp|mfe-ws|shell)
      # nginx images: check web root has index.html
      if docker run --rm --entrypoint sh "$img" -c 'test -f /usr/share/nginx/html/index.html' 2>/dev/null; then
        echo "OK   $img (frontend dist present)"; ok=$((ok+1))
      else
        echo "FAIL $img (no index.html)"; fail=$((fail+1)); failed="$failed $img"
      fi ;;
    *)
      # backend images: entrypoint script must exist
      ep=$(docker inspect --format '{{.Config.Entrypoint}}' "$img" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '[]" ' | cut -d, -f1)
      if [ -n "$ep" ] && [ "$ep" != "null" ]; then
        if docker run --rm --entrypoint sh "$img" -c "test -e '$ep'" 2>/dev/null; then
          echo "OK   $img (entrypoint $ep present)"; ok=$((ok+1))
        else
          echo "FAIL $img (entrypoint $ep missing)"; fail=$((fail+1)); failed="$failed $img"
        fi
      else
        echo "SKIP $img (no entrypoint)"; ok=$((ok+1))
      fi ;;
  esac
done < /tmp/images.txt
echo "===================="
echo "OK=$ok FAIL=$fail"
[ -n "$failed" ] && echo "FAILED:$failed"
VEOF
chmod +x /tmp/verify.sh && /tmp/verify.sh 2>&1 | tail -45
